span.p:
Customer Placement Request
POST /api/v1/placement/select-regions
customer_id, prod_region, vm_sku, vm_count, policy_id

span.p:
Load RegionalSnapshot from Redis
(5-min cache; staleness check)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Load PlacementPolicy
(weights α β γ δ ε, thresholds, ratios)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Candidate Pool
= All managed regions EXCEPT prod_region

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HC-1
REGION_SEPARATION
NonProd ≠ Prod
DR ≠ Prod
(DR may share NonProd)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HC-3
QUOTA_FLOOR
Group headroom ≥
requested_qty × vCPU
(Prod Group / NonProdDR Group)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HC-4
DR_SEPARATION_CLASS
Separation_Class
(DR, Prod) = HIGH
(non-paired regions only)

span.p:
Eligible Regions Pool
(scored separately for NonProd and DR)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PS_NonProd(r) =
α·CRG_Score
+ β·Quota_Score(NonProd)
+ γ·Distribution_Score
+ δ·DR_Buffer_Score
+ ε·Zone_Score

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PS_DR(r) =
α·CRG_Score
+ β·Quota_Score(DR)
+ γ·Distribution_Score
+ δ·DR_Buffer_Score × 1.5 ← boosted
+ ε·Zone_Score

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Weights: α+β+γ+δ+ε = 1.0
Configured in PlacementPolicy
DR_Buffer_Score weighted higher for DR placement

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NonProd Region =
argmax PS_NonProd(r)
over eligible pool

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DR Region =
argmax PS_DR(r)
over eligible pool
(DR may select same region as NonProd)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CustomerRegionAssignment written
prod_region | nonprod_region | dr_region
score_breakdown (full audit)
snapshot_timestamp

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Response 202
assignment: {prod, nonprod, dr regions}
scores per candidate
operation_id for polling
